Why Locals Come Back

What reviewers keep saying about the shop on Torrens Road.

Fades done right

Reviews rave about clean, sharp fades — it's the shop's whole reputation, and the crew takes the blend seriously.

Good energy

A young, upbeat crew that hypes you up while you're in the chair. Friendly service is the other thing reviews mention again and again.

Easy to get in

Open seven days from 10 AM, walk-ins welcome, kids looked after. No fuss — come in, sit down, walk out fresh.
